integrity: The positivity formula is derived from explicit degree-two moment equations; a published flat-kernel limit theorem is attributed rather than claimed. A standalone exact-moment and numerical probability checker is included. No claim of external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact probability and optimal sampling-scale uniqueness concern three independent one-dimensional Gaussian nodes and the flat Gaussian-kernel limit only; not positive weights at finite inverse lengthscale, integration error, numerical conditioning, or all sampling laws. Strict log-concavity is proved analytically, decimals are numerical approximations.
title: A uniquely optimal Gaussian sampling scale for positivity of three-node flat-kernel quadrature
